ocr.notes: Matches the image. Dateline 'ST. LOUIS, Feb. 26.' not transcribed.

summary.suggested: The Kansas City Journal reported that Tom Allen was under arrest at the St. Louis Four Courts, charged with murder after a man he shot in his saloon died; Allen said he thought the man was about to shoot him.

metadata.notes: Masthead: The Kansas City Journal, Monday, February 27, 1899, page 5.

facts.fact: Allen was charged with murder and held at the Four Courts after the man he shot in his saloon died; he said he thought the man was going to shoot him

notes: The paper misspells the victim as 'Tom Coupry'; he is Timothy Confoy (articles 179, 180).
